title: Export Tokens
description: Whether to export design tokens as Mitosis theme and CSS variables.

title: Export Components
description: Whether to export components into Mitosis universal JSX (.lite.tsx) files.

title: Component File Extension
description: File extension for generated Mitosis components (.lite.tsx only).

title: Use CSS Variables
description: Generate tokens.css file with CSS Custom Properties for style integration.

title: Generate Index File
description: Generate a root index.ts barrel exporting all components and tokens.

title: Show Disclaimer
description: Add an automated generation warning banner to the top of every generated file.

default: This file was generated automatically by Supernova Mitosis Exporter. Do not edit directly.
title: Disclaimer Text
description: Custom text for the file disclaimer.

title: Tokens Directory
description: Directory relative to export destination where tokens will be written.

title: Components Directory
description: Directory relative to export destination where Mitosis components will be written.

title: Token Indentation Spaces
description: Spaces for token JSON and CSS indentation. Mitosis components use the TypeScript AST printer standard four-space formatting.
